commands.review_summary:
The branch replaces Discord webhook success-response `response.json()` with a 1 MiB bounded read plus tolerant JSON fallback and adds a mocked Vitest suite for normal, oversized, empty, and malformed success responses.

PR surface: Source +10, Tests +120. Total +130 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. source-level. Current main and the latest release read a successful Discord webhook response with native `response.json().catch`, so a large body is buffered before parsing; I did not run live Discord proof in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] Contributor action is still required for real changed-path proof, and maintainers need to accept the cap/fallback behavior after the mechanical test import fix.

target.title: fix(discord): bound webhook JSON response reads to prevent OOM
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`extensions/discord/src/send.webhook.ts:124` calls raw `response.json()` on the webhook POST response. Without a byte cap, a misbehaving or compromised webhook endpoint could return an arbitrarily large response, exhausting memory.

## Changes

- `send.webhook.ts`: replace unbounded `response.json()` with `readResponseWithLimit` (1 MiB cap) + `JSON.parse` with try/catch fallback
- `send.webhook-bounded-json.test.ts`: 4 vitest tests that call the real `sendWebhookMessageDiscord()` with mocked fetch

## Evidence

### Vitest — exercises sendWebhookMessageDiscord directly

```
pnpm exec vitest run extensions/discord/src/send.webhook-bounded-json.test.ts

 ✓ parses normal JSON webhook response
 ✓ rejects oversized webhook response exceeding the 1 MiB cap
 ✓ falls back to empty payload on empty success response
 ✓ falls back to empty payload on malformed JSON success response
```

### Call chain (production)

`sendWebhookMessageDiscord(text, opts)` → `POST https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...` → `readResponseWithLimit(response, 1 MiB)` → `JSON.parse(body)` + try/catch fallback `{}` → `createDiscordSendResult`

### Negative control

Reverting `readResponseWithLimit` to `response.json()` in the oversized test:
- Before (main): `response.json()` buffers all 2 MiB → no error → unbounded OOM risk
- After (PR): `readResponseWithLimit` rejects at 1 MiB → `Error: Discord webhook JSON response too large`

Label: security | merge-risk: 🟢 minimal | AI-assisted
